subject.title: feat(browser): add secure per-tab copilot panel

question: Should this feature merge only after scoped clients are denied the legacy broad `sessions.subscribe` path, with any compatibility exception explicitly designed and tested?
rationale: The feature intentionally creates a new cross-session security boundary, and choosing whether another scoped client may retain broad subscription semantics is a durable Gateway contract decision.

options.title: Deny broad scoped subscriptions
options.body: Reject legacy broad subscriptions for `session-scoped-events` clients and rely on the existing per-session subscription API.

options.title: Design a compatible scoped variant
options.body: Retain a separately documented broad mode only if it has an authoritative per-session filtering contract and upgrade tests.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer the side-panel merge until the subscription model has an owner-approved security design.

recommendation.title: Deny broad scoped subscriptions
recommendation.body: Reject legacy broad subscriptions for `session-scoped-events` clients and rely on the existing per-session subscription API.

likelyOwner.reason: Owns the current integration and can coordinate the required Gateway contract decision with the adjacent hardening contributor.
